subject: Procurement: PO metadata, remit paths & invoice routing for Quill Health
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@quillhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@quillhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO metadata, remit addresses and invoice routing questions

Hi Olga,

We're moving forward with Redwood for the pilot and procurement needs a few clarifications so our AP team can issue a PO:  

- We require each invoice to include the following PO metadata fields: our internal PO number, BU code, project code, and a Redwood contract reference (we can map to your master agreement if you provide an ID).
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices per BU are preferred, but we may need some line-items split to different vendor codes.
- Net terms: standard is Net45 for us. Can you confirm Redwood accepts Net45? Any early-pay discounts available?
- Multi-entity remit: we sometimes split payment across two remit entities (Quill Health North / Quill Health East) depending on the BU. Is it possible to receive separate invoices tied to different remit addresses while keeping a single PO?
- We attached our PO template for your billing team. Can you confirm whether the PDF fields map to your invoicing system (billing_entity, tax_id, remit_address)?

Also: pricing question — procurement needs confirmation of the committed-spend discount slab that applies if we hit the Q3 minimums referenced in the SOW. If there are packaging or SKU-level constraints that change discount eligibility, flag them.

Attachment: [Quill_PO_template.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Li
Sr. Procurement Manager, Quill Health
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@quillhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO metadata, remit addresses and invoice routing questions

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list and the PO template. Quick summary and a couple clarifying Qs below.

Summary of what we can support immediately:
- We can accept Net45 on the hosted/enterprise plan.
- Monthly consolidated invoices per BU are supported. We can also produce separate invoices tied to different remit addresses if you provide the BU-to-remit mapping in the PO.
- Our invoices can include custom fields (billing_entity, tax_id, PO number, project code, contract_ref) but we need an exact field name mapping for automated ingestion.

Questions / constraints:
1) If you require separate invoices to different vendor codes while issuing a single PO, we need the PO to enumerate the invoice split percentages or line-item routing. Otherwise we will default to single consolidated invoice per PO.
2) For discount slabs tied to committed spend: our pricing team applies slabs at the billing_entity level. That means for multi-entity remit, eligibility is evaluated per billing_entity unless you centralize spend under one entity.
3) Do you need separate W-9 / tax forms per remit entity? That impacts how we store tax ids on file.

I've looped in Vivek (finance lead) and Priyom (contracts) to propose operational options. I also attached our current pricing commitment sheet showing slab thresholds — this lists the eligible SKUs and packaging constraints; note that custom packaging (per-customer bundles) can affect qualified spend.

Attachments: [Redwood-pricing-commitment-sheet.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)]

Next steps: Vivek will propose a billing flow and early-payment incentive options. If you can reply with a sample PO with the BU mapping filled, we can validate mapping to our AR system.

Best,
Olga
Head of Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@quillhealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO metadata, remit addresses and invoice routing questions

Samantha / team — Vivek here (finance). Appreciate the template — reviewed and I have a workable counterproposal / notes below.

1) Net terms: We can accept Net45. Standard process: monthly invoice run on the 1st of the month for the prior month usage. Payment due Net45 from invoice date.

2) Early payment discount: We can offer a 1.5% early-payment discount if Quill pays within 15 days (Net15). Alternatively we can provide a 2% discount on the monthly invoice if you commit to an accelerated payment cadence (monthly pre-pay) and hit the committed spend threshold per quarter.

3) Invoice splitting & remit mapping:
- We will honor separate invoices per remit entity if the PO populates a routing table: {"po_line_id": "remit_entity_id"}. If you cannot supply line-level mapping, provide a simple split percentage per BU and we will allocate invoices accordingly.
- Requirement: PO must include the Redwood contract reference (Contract ID: RW-2027-4532) — that assures correct mapping in our AR.

4) Billing entity / discount eligibility: Discounts are applied at billing_entity level. For quotes that span multiple entities, discounts will be pro-rated unless you centralize billing under a single entity. 

5) Tax docs: we need a W-9 or equivalent per remit entity. We can accept these via secure upload to our portal.

6) DocuSign / amendment: If the PO requires contract language changes (e.g., to acknowledge multi-entity billing or different invoicing cadence), Priyom will prepare a short amendment and route for signature.

Action items: 
- Samantha: send a sample PO with BU -> remit mappings (even a one-line example will do).
- Quill AP: confirm whether they want early-pay discount (Net15) vs. pro-rated slab approach.
- Marissa / Priyom: I'll need a final billing_entity mapping before we enable separate invoices.

DocuSign (amendment draft will follow): https://docusign.com/s/awf-4532 
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4532

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@quillhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@quillhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO metadata, remit addresses and invoice routing questions

Thanks Vivek — couple quick clarifications from procurement/finance side:  

- We need separate invoice numbers tied to each vendor code for our ERP reconciliation; consolidated PDF per month is fine as long as each invoice is distinct and references the same PO number.
- About discounts: if Redwood can waive the early-pay discount in favor of a higher committed-spend slab (i.e., guarantee $X spend in Q3), would you provide a larger slab discount (we're suggesting moving from 5% to 7% at the Q3 threshold)? That would simplify our cashflow planning.

Samantha will upload a mock PO with the BU mapping later today. Also we can provide W-9s for both remit entities.

—Raj
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@quillhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO metadata, remit addresses and invoice routing questions

Samantha / Raj — thanks for the fast replies. Internal summary + next steps below.

Internal summary (for records):
- Net45 accepted; alternative Net15 early-pay (1.5%) or 2% for pre-pay + committed-spend model.
- Discount slabs applied at billing_entity; multi-entity pro-rates unless centralized.
- We can produce separate invoice numbers per remit entity; Quill must provide BU->remit mapping or line-level routing.
- Required documents from Quill: sample PO with mapping, W-9s (for each remit entity).
- Contract reference to use: RW-2027-4532 — Priyom to prepare a short amendment if Quill wants slab language inserted.

Marissa action items (I'll own):
1) Prepare a one-page summary for Quill that shows three billing flows (single consolidated invoice, split invoices per remit, and pre-pay/discount flow) with example invoice headers. I'll attach that PDF to the summary.
2) Coordinate with Priyom on amendment language once Quill confirms slab preference.
3) Ensure AR can accept the Quill PO template fields; I'll validate mapping and reply with any required field-name changes.

Samantha: expect my summary doc later today. If you send the mock PO, we'll validate in our AR testing sandbox and confirm the field mapping.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
